oldCity.name: Blue Mosque
oldCity.note: Pause in the outer courtyard before entering; the cascading domes are easiest to understand from here.

oldCity.name: Hagia Sophia
oldCity.note: Look upward before focusing on individual details—the scale and layered history are the main event.

oldCity.name: Basilica Cistern
oldCity.note: The Medusa bases are memorable, but the changing reflections and forest of columns define the experience.

oldCity.name: Topkapı Palace
oldCity.note: Treat it as a sequence of courtyards and viewpoints rather than a single European-style palace.

bosphorus.name: Spice Bazaar
bosphorus.note: Walk through once before buying. Compare freshness, packaging and price away from the busiest entrances.

bosphorus.name: Public ferry
bosphorus.note: Outdoor seating provides the most useful city orientation; keep the phone secure near railings.

bosphorus.name: Waterfront pause
bosphorus.note: Leave unscheduled time to watch ferries and cargo traffic—the strait is part of the city’s daily rhythm.
